title.zh: 哈希 · 把任意输入压成固定指纹
title.en: Hashing · Squeezing Any Input Into a Fixed Fingerprint

desc.zh: 任意长度的输入变成固定长度的指纹：雪崩效应、哈希表里的冲突、生日悖论，以及指纹到底要多少位才够。
desc.en: Any-length input becomes a fixed-length fingerprint: the avalanche effect, collisions in hash tables, the birthday paradox, and how many bits a fingerprint really needs.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
